visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a blue ceramic plate featuring golden-brown, crispy banana rolls drizzled with dark chocolate. The dish is garnished with green grapes, cherry tomatoes, and a pink flower, set against a bright studio background. (2) A person's hand with manicured nails picks up a roll and breaks it in half, revealing a steaming, soft yellow banana filling inside the crunchy outer layer. (3) The scene transitions to a wooden countertop where hands mix white sugar and brown cinnamon powder in a small glass dish, followed by adding a spoonful of white cornstarch to another small bowl. (4) A yellow banana is peeled and sliced lengthwise on a wooden cutting board into long strips, which are then placed on a white plate and dusted with the sugar-cinnamon-starch mixture. (5) Spring roll wrappers are laid flat; a banana strip is placed at the bottom third, and fingers tightly roll it up, sealing the edge with a small amount of water. (6) The rolls are deep-fried in a pan of bubbling oil until the skins turn a deep golden brown and become brittle. (7) A male host in a white t-shirt and a blue striped apron stands in a kitchen with a white brick wall, holding the plate of finished rolls. He takes a large bite, displaying a crunching motion and a satisfied facial expression.

The music continues steadily in the background, maintaining its upbeat energy while the narrator explains the proportions of sugar and cinnamon. (3) A subtle rustling sound of pastry wrappers followed by a crisp sizzling sound marks the next phase as the rolls enter the hot oil. The sizzling noise is a broadband texture that indicates high temperature, while the narrator continues to offer technical cooking tips. The music reaches a light cadence, and the host's voice exhibits high positive valence as he praises the final taste.
